main_text.p: Historiam appositè orator, Testem temporis, Nuncram vetustatis, lucem veritatis, vitam memoriæ, & Magistram vitæ dixit. Porro ingrati incolæ indicium est, res foris gestas perlustrasse, & in domesticis hospitem atque peregrinum exîstere. Quæ res me permovit, ut Clivensium, Iuliacensium, Bergensium, Geldriensium, Marckensium, Ravensburgicorum, &c. historiam contexerem. Res ardua & viribus meis impar: quicquid tamen ex fide dignis & authenticis auctoribus, vel manuscriptis variis, quorum multa ex ipso quoque Archivo Principum desumpta mihi videre & evolvere datum, observare licuit, hic ordine, addità temporis, quæ anima historiæ est, perfecta supputatione, & quidem quantum fieri poterit brevi orationis filo, consignabo. Ut autem certa constet hujus historiæ methodus, ad quam tum scriptor collimavi, tum studiosus lector ceu Cynosuram perpetuam respiciat, primo omnium de Gentium & populorum in conjunctis hisce partibus origine, eorundemque propagatione, donec ipsis Dynastæ, Comites, Marchiones, Duces præessent, dicam. Deinde cum paulatim in Dynastias, Comitatus, Marchionatus, Ducatus erigerentur, qui & quot illis ex ordine præfuerint, & quicquid præclari, toga vel sago gesserint, adijciam.
Note: the scan is a printed page with a large initial H; the text is transcribed as printed, with the initial "H" joined to "Historiam" as a woodcut-style initial.

page.notes: The large initial "H" is joined to the first word. Some words are printed with irregular spacing ("ceuCynosuram", "Vt autem") and are left as printed. The first word "Historiam" is read from the initial H plus "istoriam" and is transcribed as "Historiam".
